_comment: Language-ablation conditions (C0-C8) + scene_graph + covgate for all 12 SO101 real-robot tasks. C0 = standard full instruction. scene_graph = VLM-augmented (built at runtime). C1-C8 = ablation variants. C2 (garbage) and C3 (shuffled, seed=42) are FIXED so all trials of a task use identical strings.

conditions.C2: Random garbage (fixed nonsense words, same across all tasks)
conditions.C6: Objects only (no spatial relation, no verb)
conditions.C7: Wrong object (one key object swapped to a wrong one)
conditions.scene_graph: C0 instruction prefixed with VLM scene-graph at episode start
conditions.covgate: C0 instruction with CovGate K=4 variance reduction (no language change)

_schedule_note: 10-episode default cycle (Option B): each env setup runs exactly one condition. C8 can be added as episode 11 if extra trials are available.
